title: Group By

parameters.name: by
parameters.description: List of the input columns to group on.

parameters.name: auto_rename_columns
parameters.description: If true (default), aggregated column names include the operation as a suffix (e.g. Value.sum). If false, column names are left as-is; use a dictionary entry to supply a custom output name (e.g. - Value: Total).

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Group and return all values for these column(s) as a list.

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: The first value for these column(s).

parameters.name: last
parameters.description: The last value for these column(s).

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: The minimum value for these column(s).

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: The maximum value for these column(s).

parameters.name: mean
parameters.description: The mean (average) value for these column(s).

parameters.name: median
parameters.description: The median value for these column(s).

parameters.name: nunique
parameters.description: The count of unique values for these column(s).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The count of values for these column(s).

parameters.name: counts
parameters.description: Return a dictionary containing the count of each distinct value for these column(s). Keys are converted to JSON-safe strings; missing values use the key "null" and booleans use lowercase "true"/"false".

parameters.name: std
parameters.description: The standard deviation of values for these column(s).

parameters.name: sum
parameters.description: The total of values for these column(s).

parameters.name: any
parameters.description: Return true if any of the values for these column(s) are true.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Return true if all of the values for these column(s) are true.

parameters.name: p75
parameters.description: Get a percentile. Note, you can use any integer here for the corresponding percentile.

parameters.name: custom.*
parameters.description: Placeholder for custom functions. Replace 'placeholder' with the name of the function.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Group and aggregate the data ## Migrated examples #### Grouping By One Column ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - select.group_by: by: - Product Type sum: Quantity mean: Price ($) ```
##### Input Sample | Product | Quantity | Price ($) | Product Type | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Hammer | 3 | 12.99 | Hand Tools | | Ratchet Wrench | 12 | 6.99 | Hand Tools | | Cordless Drill | 2 | 49.99 | Power Tools | | Reciprocating Saw | 7 | 29.99 | Power Tools |
##### Output Sample | Product Type | Quantity.sum | Price ($).mean | | --- | --- | --- | | Hand Tools | 15 | 9.99 | | Power Tools | 9 | 39.99 |
#### Grouping With Custom Function Aggregation ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - select.group_by: by: Category custom.sum_times_two: Quantity ```
##### Input Sample | Category | Quantity | | --- | --- | | Hand Tools | 3 | | Hand Tools | 1 | | Hand Tools | 2 | | Power Tools | 4 |
##### Output Sample | Category | Quantity.sum_times_two | | --- | --- | | Hand Tools | 12 | | Power Tools | 4 |
